notes.title: 【Massive NPC Dynamics & Environmental Sound effects Added】May 30th Update
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We're truly sorry to have kept you all waiting! We've poured a great deal of effort into polishing this update, striving to bring you an even better gaming experience.

Firstly, the lives of our town residents have become much more vibrant and varied! We've meticulously designed more diverse daily routines for our existing residents. Now, they will display distinctly different schedules based on the day of the week and weather conditions, accompanied by a massive amount of new, unique dialogue, making daily life in town even more full of surprises.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807841/ce6c27bd15506f34710c2214081b2afcc9332abe.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807841/4bf3a01ae5bb80a09be185cb6478858c36384124.gif[/img]

At the same time, our bustling town welcomes two new friends—Pippa and Maisie! We hope you'll enjoy meeting them in the game and unlocking heartwarming new stories together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807841/c9f2bf244b2411d7641b850ad1d02d83381bfb46.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807841/12a1acf0212c829e942dff0bf97628ae7f914ca4.png[/img]

In terms of auditory experience, we've also implemented a comprehensive upgrade: we've added ambient sound effects for scenes like campfires, waterfalls, and streams, as well as nuanced environmental sounds for different weather conditions such as rainy and windy days. These changes will significantly enhance your immersion and sense of realism within the game world.

Looking ahead, we won't stop here; we're committed to bringing you more exciting dialogues, richer content, and refined details in future updates. The story of our town is still unfolding—stay tuned!

Notice: The Gifting System is temporarily closed for maintenance. We are adding a more complex gifting system and dialogue feedback in the next version! It is currently disabled for development reasons. Thanks for your understanding!

If you encounter any bugs during gameplay, please report them to us immediately. We will fix them and release updates promptly.

notes.title: March 11, 2025 Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
Fixed Issues:
1.Fixed crash occurring when selecting drinks from the menu.
2.Fixed issues with skipped Cutscene or frame drops during the storyline comforting Stellar in the R&D room.
3.Fixed overly fast pop-up tutorial flashbacks in the R&D room.
4.Fixed missing button prompts when selling items in the shop.
5.Fixed UI overflow issue with the judgment bar on the synthesis pot.
6.Fixed several text errors and the "?" font display issue in the English version.
7.Fixed controller misalignment and complete button misplacement issues on Steam Deck.
8.Fixed incorrect Town UI appearing within Dream sequences.
9.Added UI prompts to both the employee selection and drink selection screens.
10.We're currently addressing frame drop issues within Dream sequences. The fix will be implemented immediately upon resolution.
11.Attempted fixes for several crash issues.

Known Issues & Upcoming Improvements:

Controller Optimization:
We've addressed reported controller issues promptly with patches. Further optimizations for controller operation are coming soon. Additionally, we're working on a customizable button mapping feature to accommodate different player preferences.

UI Improvements:
We're overhauling the UI display logic and key binding system, with a major optimization planned soon!

Screen Switching Issue:
We're aware of and currently testing fixes for display alignment problems after minimizing and returning to the game. Once stability across various window resolutions is ensured, the fix will be integrated.

Game Saving Functionality:
Currently, the game auto-saves during nighttime sleep. Given player requests for manual saving, we’re prioritizing development on a manual save feature to be introduced as quickly as possible.

We appreciate your patience and support. Should you encounter any bugs or have suggestions, we commit to swiftly addressing them.

notes.title: DEV LOG #01
notes.content:
Hello everyone, It has been a long time since we updated our progress! Let's take a look at the recent changes！

[h2]1️⃣New Features[/h2]

[h3]🎒Backpack + Map System
[/h3]
We have developed and improved the backpack and map systems. Players can view and check their tools by opening the item page in the main menu. Players can drag the mini-map to view their destination on the map page. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807841/a1b9df3e2e64f7e095c58039a1781da0428e88a9.gif[/img]

[h3]🛋"Decorate Room" Feature[/h3]

We have updated the furniture placement system in the milk tea shop. Players can buy tables or chairs to decorate the shop. The new tables and chairs can attract customers and generate more profits. Try to make more money and buy as much furniture as you can! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807841/bba2381a7b0558d4d2421295474c880e121a003e.gif[/img]

[h2]2️⃣Seasons and Weather System[/h2]

We just finished the seasons and weather system. Players can experience fun weather effects like rain, falling leaves, and snow. They can also perceive the changes in seasons through environmental transformations. Tapioca Town is becoming a wonderful cozy place for living!

🌧Mystery house in the rain

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807841/a788430b78066d5e5675d9df9be6707e0d0effec.gif[/img]

🍂Falling Autumn leaves

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807841/a2465c3c230d1d5332b67e9491862abcbbfad079.gif[/img]

❄️Winter Lake

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807841/89f19ad6a00d715327fd99273e9463f0e40ab3b5.gif[/img]

[h2]3️⃣A new area has been added[/h2]

A new area has been added—the Community Activity Center. We have also added facilities such as Tapioca Town Fountain Square, the Hero Statue, and the Town Notice Board in this area. New NPCs and dialogues have also been completed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807841/f9ffeb0934836f7f4cb03ec747695f53b694df22.gif[/img]

[h2]4️⃣Fixed known bugs[/h2]

Resolved issues related to game crashes and interface display problems in the playtest, enhancing the game's stability.

Next, we will focus on completing the remaining development work. Thank you all for your support and feedback. We will continue to work hard to bring more exciting content to Call of Boba!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

⭐️[b]Stay tuned for more updates, and feel free to join our community for fun and discussions![/b]
